papers.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
papers.summary: Long-horizon search agents must make multiple sequential actions (steps) to search, retrieve, verify, and integrate evidence to reach a final answer. However, existing methods for training these agents typically treat all steps within a trajectory uniformly during both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), failing to distinguish useful actions from erroneous or redundant ones. papers.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
papers.summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models can produce visually compelling images, yet they remain limited on open-world tasks that require complex semantic understanding, multi-step reasoning, and the integration of external world knowledge. Existing efforts introduce agent capabilities into image generation, but they either prescribe a fixed workflow or place only a subset of the open-world image generation process under agent control. papers.title: OneDayAgent: Towards a Long-Horizon Harness for Autonomous Agents
papers.summary: LLM agents are increasingly applied to open-ended everyday requests that span work, study, and life. These tasks are long-horizon, cross-environment, and multimodal, forcing the agent to preserve goals and constraints across many steps while navigating heterogeneous tools and attachments. papers.title: GDPevo: Evaluating Agent Self-Evolution on Real Business Tasks
papers.summary: Agent self-evolution updates an agent's persistent state from prior experience and reuses it to solve related tasks more effectively. papers.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning
papers.summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. papers.summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed within agentic systems, their capabilities depend not only on the model weights but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, control flow, memory, and orchestration code surrounding them. papers.title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?

papers.title: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents
